metadata.description: Layer manifest for the Better Mapandan GIS map page. Each layer declares its title (trilingual), data file, type, visibility, source, and verification state.

layers.source: OpenStreetMap (municipality relation polygon extracted from datasets/GIS/administrative.geojson) + PSA/PSGC
layers.verification_notes: No verified boundary polygons available. The OSM administrative.geojson contains bounding-box geometries (@geometry: bounds), not true polygon boundaries. Barangay features use geometry: null (PSGC provides codes/names only, not geometry). The approximate extraction bounds [15.98, 120.41] to [16.05, 120.52] are used for map centering only.

layers.source: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) — PSGC 2Q 2026 & Census of Population 2024
layers.verification_notes: 15 barangay records with official PSGC codes (0105528001–0105528018). Populations sum to 38,228 matching PSA 2024 census. All verified from source.

layers.source: OpenStreetMap / Google Maps Plus Codes (via datasets/GIS/evac.geojson)
layers.verification_notes: All 16 facilities carry verification_status: source_verified and are rendered. Coordinates are approximate Plus Code cell centers (§3.5). 5 formerly blocked facilities (fac-001, fac-002, fac-005, fac-006, fac-014) were released for publication following maintainer review decision on 2026-10-19.
OSM road LineStrings. Served as-is from existing GIS inventory. No independent field verification performed.
OSM amenity features (schools, hospital, etc.). Served as-is from existing GIS inventory.

layers.source: Better Mapandan entity system (DPWH project records with lat/lon for located projects)
layers.verification_notes: Projects with latitude/longitude from DPWH records are rendered as point markers linked to the Project Explorer. Projects without coordinates remain in Project Explorer only — no synthetic coordinates are assigned.

KMZ contains GroundOverlay PNG tile images with LatLonBox georeferencing, WGS84. Not vector geometry. Legend and precise georeferencing controls have not been independently verified. Rendered as a semi-transparent raster overlay with a non-real-time disclaimer.
